theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

top_news.title: US Stock Futures Advance on AI Earnings Boost: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: US equity-index futures rose along with contracts for Asian equities as strong earnings from some of the biggest beneficiaries of the artificial intelligence boom revived optimism over the tech trade.

top_news.title: Brazil Election: Bolsonaro Says He’d Work With US, China as President
top_news.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro said he would work with the US and China if he becomes Brazil’s president, after a surprise election performance left him poised to join a wave of conservative leaders pushing Latin America closer to Washington.

top_news.title: AI Stocks Rally After Super Micro Preliminary Sales Bring Relief
top_news.summary: The shares of AI-related companies rallied in after-hours trading on Tuesday after strong preliminary results from server-maker Super Micro Computer Inc. spurred relief about the outlook for spending on the technology.

top_news.title: Surprising Netflix Is Not Looking at Other Opportunities: Fmr. Content Director
top_news.summary: Simon Gallagher, Hanaging Director of SPG Global and a Former Netflix Content-Acquisition Director, says hiring Peter Rice signals a more commercial programming strategy. While niche titles can succeed, Gallagher argues Netflix should lean more toward broadly appealing films and shows to support growth. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: PGIM’s Bryan McDonnell on 2027 Real Estate Credit Market
top_news.summary: Bryan McDonnell, Head of Real Estate Credit Strategies at PGIM, says investors should adjust business models to a higher-rate environment rather than count on rates falling. He describes the market’s recent uncertainty as a gap between rate expectations and reality, with Treasury yields rising above 5% after expectations briefly converged around 4%. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Jess Menton on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Stocks Climb in Late Hours After SpaceX’s Earnings: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks rose in late hours as SpaceX reported solid earnings fueled by a big jump in its artificial-intelligence business.

top_news.title: Lithium Miner PLS Sells $700 Million Bond in Expansion Push
top_news.summary: PLS Group Ltd returned to the US dollar bond market, braving a junk-debt selloff as the Australian lithium miner lines up investments to expand production.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 20
top_news.summary: Brent oil edged lower in a choppy session, with traders parsing the status of negotiations between the US and Iran against a backdrop of persistent unrest in the Middle East.

top_news.title: Russian Satellite Raises Space Warfare Fears
top_news.summary: Clayton Swope, deputy director of the CSIS Aerospace Security Project, said that we shouldn't look at movement in Space as separate from what countries do on on earth, after a Russian satellite approached an American satellite used by Ukraine. Swope said that the move should be evaluated as an 'example of Russia doing hybrid warfare zone activities that threaten US interests and European interests' and is all part of the same geopolitical problem as the Russia Ukraine war.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Carney to Unveil Budget Nov 5 as PBO Warns Oil Windfall Gone
top_news.summary: Canada’s federal government will unveil its spending plans on Nov. 5 as the country’s budget watchdog says new measures, including a major tax incentive for businesses, will cost more than an oil-driven revenue windfall brings in.
